scope: New model: receiver has no free counts, endpoint or raw path; all data-dependent prediction information travels through fixed-length binary inputs to a known fixed finite-output memoryless channel. First-order table, arbitrary initial pair, pointwise <=k source edits preserving terminal pair; same procedure for every k.
result: Distinct channel rows: total physical-input length Theta_W(log M) for feasible constant g_M factors. Identical rows: clean Bayes risk >=1/8, normalized factor >=sqrt(M)/8 regardless of R.
lower: Every law-independent randomized protocol: risk >=1/(8*2^R) on clean IID prior, hence R>=0.5 log2 M-log2(8C). Cardinality is channel-input labels, not output alphabet.
upper: Payload J,C,terminal bit,gate bit uses B=2ceil(log2(M+1))+2. Greedy distance code and maximal conditional ML error <=M^-1/2 gives Cg+1 risk factor.
resources: Basic construction charges codebook O_W(M^2 log M) bits and polynomial-in-M preprocessing/brute-force decoding. Rational-channel exact arithmetic separated from real-channel statistical existence. O(log M) scan auxiliary space excludes resident input M+2 bits. A more efficient concatenation is a separate unaccepted candidate.
root_read: Full candidate, actual storage clarification diff, complete independent review; 13 artifact bindings verified; independent checker rerun with byte-identical output. Accepted FOU/FOT002 interface earlier read in full.
limits: No efficient-neural or learnability claim, no variable/adaptive messages, feedback, uncharged query/seed, unknown or M-dependent channel. Not a sharpening of old supplemental-only model. LLM review is not formal/external peer review; local unpublished.
